## About
Frantz Automotive Center is locally owned and operated by Don and Lisa Frantz, right in the heart of downtown Cary. Our goal is simple: your complete satisfaction, both professionally and personally. Earning your trust matters to us.
Don is an ASE Certified Master Technician and leads the shop floor. Lisa handles business management, customer relations and planning. Our service manager, Darryl Phillips, estimates and authorizes your repair and service work and handles parts ordering.
Our neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating from 283 Google reviews. One customer said it plainly: call them, you will be in good hands.

## Services
- Lube, Oil and Filter Service: Routine oil and filter changes to keep your engine running right.
- North Carolina State Inspections: We're an Official North Carolina State Inspection Station.
- Brake System Service: Service for your brake system, plus anti-lock brake repair.
- Air Conditioning Service: Air conditioning service, and air conditioning system repair when something's wrong.
- Computerized Wheel Alignment: Alignment to keep your car tracking straight.
- Computer Diagnostics / Check Engine Light: When the check engine light comes on, we find out why.
- Transmission Repair and Replacement: Transmission repair, replacement and fluid service.
- Steering and Suspension Repair: For a ride that feels bumpy or steering that doesn't feel right.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on my kind of vehicle?
A: Yes. We work on foreign and domestic vehicles, whether you drive an American or import car or truck, SUV, mini van or hybrid.

Q: Can I get my state inspection done here?
A: Yes. We're an Official North Carolina State Inspection Station.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 6:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How do I schedule an appointment?
A: Give us a call at 919-469-5423 to schedule. You can also email us at frantzautomotive@hotmail.com.

- "We first came here a few months ago when one of our cars had an issue with it’s brake line breaking. What initially attracted us were the amazing reviews, but we were especially impressed to learn that they are family-owned.

When we brought that car in, they were incredibly transparent with us. They explained that they wouldn’t be able to get a brand-new part anytime soon, but they could overnight a used part rather than having us wait 6–9 months for a new one. They took such great care of our car and made the whole process so easy.

Recently, my car started making a questionable noise and eventually became unreliable. We brought it back to them, and they took the time to research the issue as much as possible. They were honest with us and explained that it was going to be an expensive repair.

When we came in to pick up my car, they remembered exactly who I was, welcomed me in, and took the time to explain everything in terms I could actually understand. They were so easy to talk to and never once made me feel talked down to.

As a younger woman, I’ve unfortunately experienced the opposite at other automotive places, where you can sometimes feel like people assume you don’t know anything about cars. That was never the case here. I genuinely felt respected, listened to, and taken care of.

Even today, when I came by to pick up my car to take it to the dealership to trade it in, they told me that if I ever have questions about the reliability of my new vehicle or common issues to look out for, I can always call them. That small gesture really stood out to me because it showed that they genuinely care about their customers, even when there’s nothing in it for them.

I cannot recommend them enough. I’ll be sending everyone I know here, and I’ll absolutely be coming back when my new car needs service. If you’ve been looking for a sign that you should give them a try, let this be it! You will not regret it.🫶" (Renee Burwell, 5/5)
